old_problem: The active record retained Engineering Decision Pending because DeepSeek's safe read-only query does not execute the Master procedure and because it treated `ib_write_bw` in Ethernet mode as transport-ambiguous. The literal verbs command is technically valid as RoCE when the approved Ethernet-mode ConnectX port has a verified RDMA device/GID and peer path; all exact identities, jumbo support, lossless settings and the 90% link oracle can remain project bindings.
disposition_reason: ED-05 keeps Ethernet distinct from InfiniBand and interprets the source's verbs command only as RoCE, never as native TCP throughput; ED-03 parameterizes the adapter/netdev/RDMA/GID/peer and switch path; ED-06 preserves the complete DC cycle; ED-15 requires a verified link-specific 90% floor; ED-13 requires hardware/path specification proof before MTU 9000 is executed or declared unsupported; ED-19/ED-20 retain this jumbo-frame variant independently from row440.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row443 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history3033 and next formal queue row444/history3034.

NVIDIA documentation uses `ib_write_bw` for paired RDMA bandwidth testing and documents ConnectX Ethernet products as RoCE-capable; the source command is therefore preserved as a RoCE test only after RDMA device/GID/path proof.

NVIDIA guidance states that jumbo capability must hold across every data-path component; local MTU 9000 alone cannot prove the source objective and some platform/NIC combinations have lower supported maxima.
The read-only DeepSeek command remains a phase-zero inventory but cannot satisfy persistent LINK_TYPE_P1=2 activation, complete DC cycle, MTU 9000 reachability or the paired performance measurement.

test_case.test_name: Mellanox Ethernet-mode RoCE bidirectional write-bandwidth test with end-to-end MTU 9000 proof
test_case.purpose: Activate the approved Mellanox P1 in Ethernet mode, prove an end-to-end jumbo-frame RoCE path at the source-required MTU 9000, and measure finite paired bidirectional RDMA Write bandwidth against 90% of the verified link payload ideal.
required_package: Pinned NVIDIA MFT, adapter firmware, MLNX_OFED or rdma-core/perftest versions matched across peers
Adapter serial/MST/BDF/P1/netdev/RDMA-device/GID/NUMA/peer/cable/switch mapping and saved prior mode/network state
Hardware and switch specifications proving Ethernet MTU 9000 support on every hop
Approved /24 addresses, VLAN, PFC/ECN/lossless policy, FEC, QoS and end-to-end jumbo validation method
Finite message/QP/depth/duration-or-iteration/repeat/statistic profile, link payload ideal, 90% floor, OOB/DC and rollback plan
test_case.test_command: Collect the DeepSeek read-only mlxconfig/ip/ethtool baseline and bind the exact P1/netdev/RDMA/GID/peer path. After specification and maintenance approval, run `mlxconfig -d <mlx device> set LINK_TYPE_P1=2`, perform the full DC OFF-to-ON-to-OS-ready cycle, configure only approved /24 endpoints and set Ethernet MTU 9000 on both hosts and every intervening switch hop. Prove jumbo reachability without fragmentation and clean counters. Then run the literal paired finite `ib_write_bw -d <ETH_device> --report_gbits -F -b -p 3000` server and matching client command against `<server_ip>`. Compare the approved statistic with 90% of the verified link payload ideal, then restore prior mode, MTU and addresses.
test_case.expected_result: The exact P1 activates in Ethernet mode after the complete DC cycle; the mapped RoCE device/GID is reachable; both hosts and all network hops prove supported MTU 9000 without fragmentation, drops or RDMA retry errors; and finite paired bidirectional bandwidth reaches at least the approved 90% floor. Prior mode/network state is restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires immutable adapter/peer/path identity, authoritative MTU 9000 support, complete cycle and jumbo-path evidence, matched RoCE commands/raw outputs, clean counters and a unit-correct 90% calculation from the verified link payload ideal. A read-only inventory, local MTU display, TCP result, unsupported MTU, missing ideal or unverified GID/path is INCONCLUSIVE—not PASS.
safety_gate: Never change an unidentified/shared management interface; require maintenance, OOB and explicit mode/DC/network authorization
Do not set MTU 9000 until both endpoints and every switch hop are proven compatible
Bound bidirectional traffic and abort on drops, pause storms, RDMA retry errors, link/FEC degradation, thermal or RAS impact
Restore prior LINK_TYPE, addresses, MTU and lossless settings; preserve logs and never retry automatically
expected_evidence: Pinned matched stack and adapter/P1/netdev/RDMA/GID/peer/switch identity map
mlxconfig before/pending/active plus full DC OFF/ON/OS-ready timeline
MTU 9000 support references, endpoint/switch configuration and no-fragment jumbo path proof
Exact finite paired commands/outputs/exits, 90% ideal derivation, restoration and verdict
test_case.recovery: If mode activation, jumbo reachability or traffic fails, stop load, preserve outputs and counters, restore saved IP/MTU/lossless settings, and use OOB to restore prior LINK_TYPE through the approved cycle. Verify management and fabric health; do not fall back to TCP, reduce MTU silently or auto-retry.

source_conflict.reason: The Master full procedure is authoritative; DeepSeek's read-only command is retained only as phase-zero evidence. `ib_write_bw` is preserved under a verified RoCE contract, resolving the alleged Ethernet/verbs ambiguity without changing coverage.

external_authorities.title: NVIDIA NCCL Networking Troubleshooting
external_authorities.applied_rule: `ib_write_bw` is an official paired RDMA bandwidth diagnostic; the device and matched peer invocation must be explicit and RDMA counters must be checked.

external_authorities.title: NVIDIA MLNX_OFED Documentation v24.01
external_authorities.applied_rule: `ib_write_bw` measures RDMA Write bandwidth between a server/client pair and supports bidirectional mode and controlled iterations/message sizes.

external_authorities.title: NVIDIA DCI Reference Design Guide — Common Topologies
external_authorities.applied_rule: Jumbo MTU must be supported end to end, including third-party layer-2/layer-3 domains.

external_authorities.title: NVIDIA Holoscan Sensor Bridge — MTU notes
external_authorities.applied_rule: Every component in the path must support the requested MTU and some ConnectX/platform contexts do not support 9000, so model-specific proof is mandatory.

project_authority: The network owner confirms the exact model/path supports MTU 9000 and binds RoCE/lossless settings, finite profile and payload ideal. If authoritative SPEC proves MTU 9000 unsupported, ED-13 governs N/A or corrected coverage rather than a fabricated PASS.
